page_objective: Define SIPANEL's icon style, usage rules, sizing, stroke behavior, accessibility requirements, and technical meaning across digital interfaces, content, and engineering communication.

iconography_philosophy.statement: SIPANEL icons must support fast technical understanding, interface clarity, and industrial professionalism.

icon_style.corner_behavior: Slightly rounded, never playful or overly soft

rules: Use 24px as the default UI icon size.
Use 32px for card and feature icons.
Use 48px only for major section visuals.
Avoid icons smaller than 16px in interactive contexts.
Use orange only for active states, CTAs, or important technical emphasis.
Avoid colorful multi-tone icon sets.
Maintain consistent icon color within each section.
Ensure sufficient contrast on dark and light backgrounds.

forbidden_usage: Icons replacing important text without labels

requirements: Icons must be understandable without excessive detail.
Icons should support technical meaning, not create ambiguity.
Engineering-specific icons must be paired with labels.
Avoid overly abstract symbols for technical concepts.
labeling_rules: Use clear text labels near technical icons.
Do not rely on icon-only communication for critical actions.
Use tooltips or helper text when meaning may be unclear.

rules: The icon itself may be smaller, but the tap area must meet minimum touch size.
Interactive icons must show hover, focus, and active states.
Close, menu, expand, and download icons must remain highly recognizable.
Avoid hover-only icon behavior on mobile.
Icons must not be the only method of communicating critical information.
All functional icons require accessible labels.
Focus states must be visible.
Maintain WCAG AA contrast.
Directional icons such as arrows and chevrons must flip in RTL layouts.
Non-directional technical icons must not flip.
Icon spacing must adapt to RTL text alignment.
Labels must remain readable in English, Persian, Arabic, and Russian.

with_text: Place icon before label in LTR layouts.
Place icon after label or mirrored before label in RTL layouts.
Maintain 8px-12px spacing between icon and text.
with_cards: Use one primary icon per card.
Avoid stacking multiple icons inside one small card.
Use icons to support scanning, not decoration.

implementation_notes: All icons should be SVG-based for scalability and performance.
Use one consistent icon library or custom SIPANEL icon set.
Iconography must support engineering clarity and fast scanning.
Avoid decorative icons that weaken SIPANEL's technical identity.
